data.text: Not now, by DEC-63 point 3 and DEC-64: no pilot data is processed on our side and no hosted code is written before the switch to a company. Paying a lawyer for ToS/privacy/DPA before then buys documents for a product that may never exist. It stays a blocker of KAD-109 (org view MVP), which is where it is due. The E2 kit carries the one legal paper pilots need now: a mutual NDA draft.
